title: Western Visayas marks martial law anniversary peacefully, cops say

blocks.text: ILOILO CITY, Philippines — The 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law was observed peacefully in Western Visayas on Monday, Sept. 21, with no major untoward incidents reported in monitored areas, according to the Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6). PRO6 said it deployed 5,155 police personnel, augmentation forces and community force multipliers across the region to secure various gatherings and activities. Police units were placed on full alert status ahead of the commemoration, with personnel tasked with maintaining visibility, managing traffic and crowds, monitoring developments and securing key areas.
